title: Read the verifier from a program of your own
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Build a Solana program on the published crate `knos-oidc-interface = "0.3.14"` (examples/reader_template is a complete one), deploy it to devnet, and send one transaction in which it reads a token knos-oidc verified.
evidence: one devnet transaction of a program your account deployed whose accounts include a token account owned by knos-oidc (FkwZdsYCmzicJMtHLTkPK76bYNVG4WNwkWJBiVWNtF3W), and the program's source naming knos-oidc-interface 0.3.14
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
